messages:
maya_sales: Quick thread for NovaCare POC 1: they asked for a SOC2 executive summary, pen-test attestation addressed to them, and a short staging network sketch. Need a deliverable by 2024-11-20. Can SE + Compliance confirm?

eli_se: @sam_compliance @olivia_legal FYI. For staging we can offer temporary VPN (mTLS) or quick SSH bastion with static egress IPs. SAML not required for initial UAT; ephemeral creds OK.

sam_compliance: We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II summary and ISO scope. Pen-test attestation: high-level only (no PoC), legal signs. If they ask for full report we require an NDA.

client_harold: Procurement: "please include legal signatory name and a line-item for any one-time VPN/setup fees + pro-rated node cost." Also prefer presigned S3 (7d) for transfer.

billing_bot: Quote snippet: Temp VPN setup = $1,000 one-time. Dedicated staging IPs = $1,200/month (pro-rated). 10-day UAT node = $800 one-time (pro-rated).

olivia_legal: Signatory: Olivia Park, GC. I can sign the attestation within 48 hours after final draft. If full report requested, NDA + 7 business days review.

maya_sales: Action items: 1) @sam_compliance prepare redacted pack + attestation draft by 2024-11-16. 2) @eli_se prepare staging diagram + ephemeral key plan. 3) Billing to send a formal amendment with line items today.

eli_se: Ephemeral key example:
```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer UAT_KEY\" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/status
```
Keys auto-expire after 14 days.

client_harold: Sounds good. We'll take the redacted pack + attestation and avoid asking for the full report to keep timeline. Thanks! :thumbsup:
